purpose: Primary sources used to prepare Force Multiplier App Store material; requirements must be rechecked when uploading.

sources.finding: Interactive app utility, accurate claims, and accessible privacy information remain review responsibilities. Source review is not Apple approval.
Test submitted builds and provide functioning contact and privacy links.
App privacy answers cover developer and integrated-partner collection. On-device-only processing and optional disclosure have specific treatment; review actual transmissions and support practices.
Use App Store Connect to provide and maintain the app's privacy answers.
The questionnaire determines regional ratings; selecting Made for Kids is a separate choice with continuing obligations.

Current required slots are medium Dynamic Island iPhone and 13-inch iPad for iPad support. One to ten PNG/JPEG images per device size; no alpha. Use the current live page, not older indexed 6.9-inch-only guidance.
Since April 28, 2026, uploaded iOS/iPadOS apps must use Xcode 26 or later and the iOS/iPadOS 26 SDK.
Name and subtitle field limits and app-record metadata.
Description, promotional text, keywords, and support fields; support URL should provide real contact details.
Public Fred Esser app listing supplies the developer website used to verify his already-published support email. It does not establish a Force Multiplier app record.
The App Store-linked developer page identifies Fred Esser and publishes fredesser@yahoo.com for questions or feedback.
